statement: For finite increasing Bernoulli event A, E_p[N_open_pivotal|A]=p(d/dp)log P_p(A); integration gives exact reverse-parameter probability ratio.
proof_or_counterexample: Recomputed Russo derivative; pivotality is independent of its own edge, and an open pivotal forces A.

statement: Bounded integrated conditional pivotal loads along a subsequence on [a,p_c], together with theta(p_c)>0, would force theta(a)>0.
assumptions: bounded integrated load on unbounded subsequence
proof_or_counterexample: L1 yields P_a(A_n)>=theta(p_c)exp(-M); decreasing-event convergence gives the conclusion.
remaining_gap: The load bound is unproved for Z^d.

statement: A locally finite nontransitive parallel-path chain has p_c=1/2, theta(p_c)>0 and bounded conditional exponential moments of endpoint open-pivotal count, but divergent fixed backward-interval load.
assumptions: block n has n^2 2^(n+1) disjoint paths of length n+1
proof_or_counterexample: Recomputed block crossing and single-path probabilities; failure <=exp(-n^2), and r_n<=n^2 exp(-n^2+1/4)/(1-exp(-1)).
remaining_gap: Does not transfer to transitive bounded-degree Z^d.

statement: Continuous monotone finite-scale functions h_n(p)=min(1,(2p)^n) can have zero limit below 1/2 and a unit limit at 1/2.
proof_or_counterexample: Direct evaluation on p<1/2 and p=1/2; monotonicities checked.
remaining_gap: Abstract functions, not percolation connection probabilities.

statement: A bounded-degree nontransitive varying-generation tree has p_c=1/2 and theta(p_c)>=4/5.
assumptions: b_k=8 for power-of-two k and 2 otherwise
proof_or_counterexample: Recomputed M_n=(2p)^n4^(1+floor(log2 n)), Q_n recursion and geometric block sum 1/4; Paley-Zygmund and subcritical first moment finish.
remaining_gap: Nontransitive tree does not address Z^d.

statement: For n-generation tree survival, f_n(1/2)-f_n(1/2-delta_n)<=delta_n n/(1/2-delta_n).
proof_or_counterexample: Open pivotals lie on any selected length-n surviving path, so Russo derivative <=n/p; integrate.
remaining_gap: Only finite-scale continuity; no fixed subcritical parameter across all n.

statement: For any finite graph law and deterministic finite A, P(o connected b)>=P(o connected A)-sum_{a in A}P(a disconnected b).
proof_or_counterexample: On {o connected A, o disconnected b}, any reached a is disconnected b; union bound.
remaining_gap: Removing the |A| factor requires new selected-relay conditioning.

statement: For almost every Bernoulli(p_c) Z^d bond configuration, independent q-retention of already open edges has no infinite component for every q<1; any hypothetical infinite critical component has quenched retention threshold one.
assumptions: independent retention conditional on base configuration
proof_or_counterexample: Annealed retained law is Bernoulli(p_c q); subcritical absence at rational q, Fubini, countable intersection, then monotone domination for all real q<1.
remaining_gap: No proof that a hypothetical critical lattice component is resilient for any q<1; L4 alone does not imply theta(p_c)=0.
